 Live Reporting
 Charlotte Coates, Jess Anderson, Michael Emons and Emily Salley
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 15:33 GMT 15:33 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 It must be tough being a goalkeeper. 
 Any mistake is so often punished with a goal. 
 36 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 15:32 GMT 15:32 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Seagulls soaring! They couldn’t, could they?
 Tom 
 Make no bones about it, there are three teams tussling for the title this season. All three have flaws. City ship goals, Arsenal's attack is limited and Brighton lack quality depth if they go deep in Europe. It will make for an interesting title race this season.
 Matt, York 
 19 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:32 GMT 15:32 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 A lot going on here.
 A fresh air shot from Erling Haaland after Jeremy Doku's cut-back in a packed penalty area.
 Elliot Anderson fires into an empty net but the offside flag had already gone up. VAR had a check for a possible penalty but nothing in it.
 City banging on the door.
 73 55 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:32 GMT 15:32 GMT 
 Hull City 0-1 Ipswich Town 
 Hull want a penalty as John Egan goes down under a challenge from Leif Davis. Nothing given. Probably the correct decision.
 That's the first we've seen from the Tigers as an attacking threat today.
 17 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds published at 15:31 GMT 15:31 GMT 
 Evanilson (31 mins) 
 James Trafford won't want to see that again. 
 Leeds go short with the goal kick and James Trafford has a head loss moment. He plays it straight to Justin Kluivert in the box and he slips it left for Evanilson to put into an open goal. 
 229 463 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:30 GMT 15:30 GMT 
 Coventry 0-0 Sunderland 
 Ooooh.
 Coventry win a free-kick in a decent position and Victor Torp goes for goal but it's tipped round the post by Robin Roefs for a corner.
 I'm not sure he needed to do that but he made sure the ball didn't find the bottom corner anyway.
 32 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 15:30 GMT 15:30 GMT 
 Hull City 0-1 Ipswich Town 
 Argentina World Cup winner Exequiel Palacios slides in late on Tim Iroegbunam, catches his ankle and the Ipswich man gets a yellow card.
 26 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Brentford 1-0 Nottm Forest published at 15:30 GMT 15:30 GMT 
 Nikola Milenkovic (own goal, 30 mins) 
 Breakthrough for Brentford. 
 Caoimhin Kelleher sets the Bees on the attack with a brilliant diagonal ball that is picked up by Dango Ouattara, who waltzes past Murillo and then fizzes in a ball for Igor Thiago.
 The Brazilian is waiting unmarked in the six yard box, but the ball doesn't get as far as him as Ouattara's pass takes a touch off Nikola Milenkovic and bounces into the goal.
 159 206 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:29 GMT 15:29 GMT 
 Bournemouth 0-0 Leeds 
 Dominic Calvert-Lewin must be horrible to play against. 
 He's so good at getting his body between the ball and the defender as he draws the foul out of James Hill. 
 204 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:27 GMT 15:27 GMT 
 Hull City 0-1 Ipswich Town 
 Emersonn flicks a ball on and the pacy Abdoul Ouattara looks to run on to it and be clean through for Ipswich. But defender Nobel Mendy has an excellent starting position and is able to make an important interception.
 Hull yet to get going.
 95 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Man City enjoying a 'good little period' published at 15:27 GMT 15:27 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Image source, Getty Images This is a good little period for Manchester City. 
 It feels like they are just getting a foothold in this match. Brighton just aren't being as successful in their build up, and Manchester City pushing them back.
 168 176 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:27 GMT 15:27 GMT 
 Bournemouth 0-0 Leeds 
 Better from Bournemouth as Tyler Adams plays it forward for Justin Kluivert, who brings it down brilliantly. 
 With his next touch, he looks for Evanilson but there's just too much on the pass. 
 56 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 15:27 GMT 15:27 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Trai Hume as a false winger is too negative from Le Bris. We beat Brentford with fast attacking wingers and a man of the match performance from Jocelin Ta Bi. When will he learn?
 Derek 
 58 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:26 GMT 15:26 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 A brilliant run from Iliman Ndiaye, swerving right and left between two defenders and somehow finding a way through but his shot is straight at Bart Verbruggen.
 City showing signs of turning this around.
 111 104 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 15:26 GMT 15:26 GMT 
 Brentford 0-0 Nottm Forest 
 James McAtee is pulling his hair out.
 The midfielder wasn't closed down and had plenty of space to drill a low strike from the edge of the box which drifts inches wide.
 53 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:25 GMT 15:25 GMT 
 Bournemouth 0-0 Leeds 
 Leeds look like the only side that's going to score this afternoon as Harry Wilson sneaks into the box but his low cross is turned behind.
 189 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Hull City 0-1 Ipswich Town published at 23 mins 23 mins 
 Florentino Luis 
 Image source, Getty Images Ipswich have dominated the ball and deservedly take the lead. Abdoul Ouattara does excellently to run at the home defence and slide a pass to his right to the unmarked Florentino Luis. 
 He keeps his composure from 12 yards out and blasts the ball into the roof of the net for his first goal in English football.
 666 191 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Brentford 0-0 Nottm Forest 
 Igor Thiago and Liam Delap could both do with a goal.
 Both strikers have scored just once in the league this season and are lacking in confidence in front of goal. Thiago has just swept a strike wide, while Delap follows that up at the other end with a blocked effort.
 46 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Should be 1-1!
 The corner comes in and Iliman Ndiaye leaps highest and he should score but he can't get his header on target.
 164 82 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Hull City 0-0 Ipswich Town 
 That Ipswich penalty shout saw Nobel Mendy have a hold of Dara O'Shea's shirt but a theatrical fall to the floor did not help the Town captain's case and nothing was given. It is a risky game that Mendy is playing though.
